decisions.reason: Digital anamnesis and consent is closely tied to the core practice software and fits the push toward digital practices, so it is likely to stay in the offer.
The education institute builds on the firm's training expertise and strengthens customer loyalty, so keeping it costs little and fits the strategy.
Remote screen sharing is an essential support tool for software customers and became even more important after the pandemic.
A performance analytics dashboard adds value to the existing data in the practice software and supports efficient practice management.
The complete practice bundle packages the core offer for new practices and is cheap to maintain.
The job and practice listing portal is distant from the core business and faces competition, but it builds community engagement at low cost, so it is kept for now.
